response.rationale: The item is electronics with days_since_delivery = 20, which is greater than 15. RET-003 (electronics returns not accepted after 15 days) applies at priority 20, which dominates the standard 30-day window rules (RET-007/RET-008 at priority 10). No higher-priority rule applies: final_sale is False (RET-012 inapplicable), defective is not True (RET-020 inapplicable), goodwill_grant is False, and fraud_hold is False. Therefore the return is ineligible.
